bio.text: Mazie Hirono has served as a U.S. Senator from Hawaii since being sworn in on January 3, 2013.

She was previously elected to Hawaii's Second Congressional District in 2006, served as lieutenant governor beginning in 1994, and served in the Hawaii House of Representatives after being elected in 1980.

According to her Senate biography, she spent her early childhood in Fukushima, Japan, moved to Hawaii at nearly age eight, and attended the University of Hawaii at Manoa and Georgetown University Law Center; she lives in Honolulu.
